ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels with isolated high-intensity clusters; macro-level ratio of white to black pixels is low (estimated <10%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark contiguous background with localized white spots. High-contrast white focal clusters at distal tips. Distinct white circular blob near the medial notch on the left lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep bounding-box depth; interior angle approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations of peaks are most prominent on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on both lobes tapering towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular white features (barnacles) located at the terminal ends of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on distal tips; distinct white circular scar adjacent to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Barnacle clusters create an irregular protruding topography at the fluke tips that alters the geometric contour.
